title.suggested: Tom Allen spars with Ned Donnelly at his trainer's benefit

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen's Gymnasium Club gave a private benefit for Ned Donnelly, who trained Allen for the Rooke fight, and that Allen and Donnelly closed the evening with a scientific sparring bout.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday, February 23, 1876

facts.fact: Allen sparred with his trainer Ned Donnelly at a private benefit for Donnelly given by the members of Tom Allen's Gymnasium Club in St. Louis
Ned Donnelly had trained Allen for his fight with George Rooke, which Rooke backed out of
